result.stdout:
usage: ghul-compiler [options] <source.ghul> ...

Compiles ghūl source files to a .NET assembly. With no -a or --sdk-ref-path,
the .NET reference assemblies are discovered from the installed SDK, so a
source file on its own is a complete command line:

    ghul-compiler hello.ghul

The output is named after the first source file unless -o says otherwise. A
program that uses the ghūl runtime needs ghul-runtime.dll beside the binary
before it will run; an MSBuild build puts it there for you.

modes:
  -A, --analyse                serve language-service requests on stdin/stdout
      --compile-server         compile one JSON request per line from stdin, replying on stdout
      --build-server           build the response file named on each line of stdin, one after another in this process
  -G, --type-check             parse and type-check only, emitting nothing
  -g, --no-type-check          parse only
      --check-complete         parse one source and print complete, incomplete or invalid
  -S, --assembler              generate code but write no assembly
      --format                 reformat the sources to standard output
      --format-in-place        reformat the source files themselves
      --format-width <cols>    column the formatter wraps at (default 100)
      --library                build a library rather than an executable

output:
  -o, --output <path>          write the assembly here
      --debug                  emit debug information; an llvm build is unoptimised unless --optimise is given
      --optimise <0-3>         the llvm target's optimisation level; 2 by default
      --native-input <path>    link this object file or archive into an llvm build; repeatable
      --native-library <name>  link the library lib<name>.a into an llvm build; repeatable
      --native-library-path <dir>
                               search <dir> for native libraries; repeatable
      --rtti                   describe the program's types for reflection on wasm
      --target-framework <tfm> target framework monike
[truncated]
